update.rate_limit.hit: Could not check for updates: the GitHub API rate limit was reached (status %d).
update.rate_limit.anonymous: Without a token GitHub accepts 60 requests an hour per IP address, shared by everything behind it. With GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN in the environment the check uses your account's allowance.
update.rate_limit.account: The limit reached is the one of the account behind GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN.
